BuyerDealStatus.title: Buyer Deal Status

buyerseatid.description: Seat ID in the buying system that the response refers to

status.description: Status of the deal in the buying system: `0` = pending approval `1` = buyer has approved (ie. non PG deal is ready for bid requests) `2` = buyer has rejected `3` = ready to serve (ie. deal is in a campaign - ready to receive bid requests, relevant especially for PG deals) `4` = active (i.e. deal is actively serving impressions) `5` = paused `6` = complete (ie. buying system shows deal has completed)
